name: 61342 · Mendota, IL
findings: ZIP 61342 (Mendota) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61342 (Mendota) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61342 (Mendota) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
